scores.label: A
scores.note: options 4-10 (immediately, without delay, without hesitation, in a hurry, with urgency, on the double, right away) are ungrammatical after 'too'; 'on the double' is also too casual

scores.label: B
scores.note: all are adjectives where 'acting too ___' needs an adverb; 'hasty' and 'quick' need only a small edit; 3 rapid, 4 swift, 5 immediate, 9 hurried, 10 speedy are wrong in form; 6 'rushed' shifts to feeling rushed; 7 'precipitous' and 8 'impetuous' are wrong in form and too rare

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 5 'too sooner' and 7 'too immediately' are ungrammatical; 6 'expeditiously' and 8 'promptly' carry positive efficiency sense and read oddly; 9 'with haste' and 10 'with alacrity' do not fit after 'too' and alacrity is too rare
